notes.title: Character skins and power attacks!
notes.content:
- 2 character skins each Valkyrie
- Skins offer an additional powerful attack that can be manually used like a "special power"
- Moved Boss HP bars to prevent overlapping UI
- Fixed EXP Bug
- Increased amount of EXP needed to level up

Please note that the special attacks may be swapped out for different attacks at a future date, we are still working on improving the attack types.

notes.title: Some tweaks
notes.content:
- Reworked the way shop works in preparation for more content
- Items require you purchase the item before it before unlocking, to prevent cheesing through skipping items
- Added cooldown timer icons to the HUD during missions in preparation for more content and to better time certain attacks

notes.title: Valkyrie Champions now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Valkyrie Champions has now been releasing into Steam Early Access![/h2]

View the launch patch notes here:

[h3]v 0.007 (Early Access Launch)[/h3]
------------

- All Beta game save data removed
- Gold and EXP Items vacuum towards you on Victory
- Complete overhaul of damage formula to allow for better progression
- EXP re-balanced
- Multiplayer EXP desync bug fixed (hopefully)
- Medal times tweaked
- Password Protected Lobbies
- ZQSD support for Azerty keyboards
- First phase in every mission has reduced Enemy HP to help get player started on the mission
- Revive recovers all HP instead of half
- Revive time reduced from 15 seconds to 12 seconds
- AI Variations for some bosses
- Small AI Variations for some monsters
- Health item drop quantity nerfed
- Pausing at end of mission softlock fix
- Artwork added for 4th Valkyrie
- Items no longer spawn on-top of level boundaries
- "MP" text changed to "Power"
- Hungarian Localization improved
